description: AnyTop (unified model trained on all Truebones ZOO skeleton classes, 9 MB): a diffusion transformer that generates 20 fps motion for any skeleton from its topology and joint names alone, with no text prompt. A new rig is introduced by its own BVH clips, from which the creator's preprocessing computes the rig's statistics. The checkpoint and its arguments file; the T5 encoder that embeds the joint names is catalogued separately. Research-only, non-commercial terms (derived from the Truebones ZOO dataset); recorded for information, never gated.
